recruitment.name: Recruitment
recruitment.text: Five eras, five vehicles. Each one brings an edge to the mission. The seventh stays locked until the end.

london.name: Q's lab
london.text: Q offers three gadgets and you can only take one. Each one helps at a different stop.

montenegro.name: The poker table
montenegro.text: Five players, one briefcase. The carrier reacts when the case moves. Read the tell.

fortknox.name: The bomb
fortknox.text: Thirty seconds, five wires and a hat in the air. Only one wire stops the clock.

scotland.name: Defending Skyfall
scotland.text: Two traps in the house and three waves of attackers in the mist.

jamaica.name: The interrogation
jamaica.text: Five questions taken from the file. Two mistakes and you are an impostor.
